content: जरठ {%a.%} [जॄ बा˚ अठ] .²1 Hard, solid. .²2 old, aged; अयमतिजरठाः प्रकामगुर्वीः परिणतदिक्करिकास्तटीर्बिभर्ति <ls>Śi. 4. 29</ls> (where जरठ means ‘hard’ also). .²3 Decayed, decrepit, infirm. .²4 Bent, bowed down, drooping. .²5 Pale, yellowish-white. .²6 Full-grown, ripe, matured; जरठकमल <ls>Śi. 11. 14</ls>. .²7 Hard-hearted, cruel. .{@-ठः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Paṇdu, father of the five Pāṇḍavas. .²2 Old age.
